purpose: Bounded end-to-end rehearsal (reduced debug scope, shorter than the campaign protocol): warm-up 30 s at 10 msg/s, measurement 120 s at 25 msg/s. Record the reduced scope explicitly; this is a measurement-chain rehearsal, not a capacity result and not a campaign step.
deviations: Bounded rehearsal: durations far below the campaign protocol (5 min warm-up / 10 s confirmation cadence) by explicit debug-scope decision.
1000 devices round-robin so per-device messages are >=1 s apart at the planned rates.
Outbound delivery to the Go sink on the load host (scripts/outbound.sh + scripts/run-with-sink.sh on the rehearsal sink port).
The live stack runs at the owner-qualified TB memory budget (1280 MiB per tb-core/tb-rule-engine replica, k as deployed); the run's manifest records the actual replica counts and limits.
v2: warm-up VUs raised to the sizing rule (rate x worst observed warm-up ack latency x 2) after v1's 12 warm-up drops; measurement step unchanged.
